extension.displayName: Colorful Recent Files: Vertical Tabs & History
extension.description: Colorful treeview of recently opened and edited files, with optional Vertical Tabs mode that syncs with open editor tabs, directory/type grouping and time-based colors.

view.recentView.name: Recent Files

configuration.title: Colorful Recent Files
configuration.groupBy.description: Recent files grouping mode: none (flat list), directory (hierarchical directory grouping), or type (uppercase extension groups).
configuration.syncWithOpenTabs.descripti: Whether to sync exclusively with currently open editor tabs, serving as a vertical tabs list.
configuration.groupByDirectory.descripti: Group recent files by their parent directories in the treeview (extended by groupBy).
configuration.colorScheme.description: Color decoration scheme: Continuous rainbow rank spectrum (interpolated smoothly from newest red to oldest purple) or time interval buckets.
configuration.showColorDotIcon.descripti: Display colored dot icon instead of the default file icon in the recent files treeview.
configuration.styleNativeExplorer.descri: Apply colorful file decorations and badges to the native VS Code Explorer as well.
configuration.maxRecentFiles.description: Maximum number of recent files to track in the workspace.
configuration.highlightMode.description: Base metric for time decoration: last access time (open/switch) or last modified time (edit/save).
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Works locally without modifying disk or running untrusted code.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Virtual workspaces are not currently supported.
